adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the DB update that persists new attendee rows happens before the external side-effect `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` (DB write at the prisma.booking.update call, then calendar update later). That calendar update is not wrapped in a try/catch and not in a transaction with the DB write, so if it throws the mutation will error out while the guests remain committed in the DB. On retry, `uniqueGuests` filters out already-persisted attendees, can become empty, and the handler throws `BAD_REQUEST` with `emails_must_be_unique_valid`, making it hard/impossible to reconcile and leaving DB vs calendar out of sync. Emails are also sent only after the calendar update, so they won’t go out in this failure mode.
